credit: Generated from relay_traffic_signal.json, which is the Blockbench source and is not loaded by the game. Two things are done to it: the eight ring segments Blockbench wrote as 157.5/135/112.5/67.5 degree turns - angles a block model cannot express, and which would have made the whole file fail to load - have their quarter and half turns folded into their coordinates, leaving a legal remainder; and the fourteen lens elements are moved out to the lamp models, since which lamps are lit changes with traffic and a baked model cannot say that. Re-export the source and this has to be regenerated. This is the part that never changes: everything but the lenses.
